ns2:section.sectionText: XGR Section restricted to Engineering Online graduate degree-seeking students in MSAE, MSCE, MCS, MSIE, and MSME. For more details on this course section, see https://grainger.illinois.edu/academics/online/courses. The XGR section is not available to other students, but the course is offered in another SP21 section. This class is also available to undergrads as an online Academic Year term offering: see https://netmath.illinois.edu/college/math-461. Non-degree students please register for MATH 461 M16 section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS:Env Engr CivilEngr ONL-UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
